policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Southwest Baptist's fifteen goals from two matches exceed the combined total of Lewis, Lincoln, Maryville, Illinois Springfield, Indianapolis, Missouri-St. Louis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell; the shape is one side and a field.

claims.text: Southwest Baptist have won both matches without conceding and open conference play at home to Missouri-St. Louis.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Three matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, and Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan. No final is missing its score.

claims.text: Upper Iowa have drawn twice and lost once, scoring one goal in all and conceding two; Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made twelve saves behind them.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Rockhurst have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme, and their two defeats have come at Fort Hays State and at home to Rogers State.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Seven different players have scored Southwest Baptist's fifteen goals; Nathaniel Velasquez has three of them, with an assist, from ten shots.

claims.text: William Jewell have yet to score, losing both their matches and conceding four, and host Lewis in their conference opener.
